lines.en: I knock on Rin's door and wait for her to answer, not knowing quite sure how this is going to go since I've never actually hung out with her in her room before.
To be fair, though, out of all of the girls in the class, she definitely seems like one of the few who would let me in without question.
Hell, I'm pretty sure she would have let me in a little while back if she hadn't left her keys at school.
But I guess all I can really do at this point is hope she comes to the door and doesn't think I'm here with any ulterior motives.
Which I kind of am, of course. But I obviously don't want her to think that.
: Who goes there?
: Your teacher.
: My teacher? What?
: Hold on a second.
I hear some shuffling from inside of the room as Rin makes whatever preparations are necessary to come greet me.
The sound of some drawers closing is immediately succeeded by the light tapping of her shoes as she puts them on and decides to come greet me in the hall instead....
: What's up? It's not like you to just show up at my door. You're more of a show up everywhere else kind of guy.
: Yeah, well I'm running out of other places to run into you, so I figured I'd come directly to your dorm this time.
: Anything in particular bring you here? Or were you just in the mood to see my face for whatever reason?
: To be fair, it's a pretty nice face and I should be forgiven for seeking it out during my free time.
: You sure you don't have anything more important to do?
: More important than hanging out with my favorite barista?
: Favorite out of...how many, exactly?
: Hey, for all you know, I could be a regular at tons of cafes.
: You wouldn't dare...
: I could be convinced to drop all of them if a certain somebody lets me in her room, though.
: Sure. That didn't sound predatory at all.
: It sounded better in my head.
: Why my room, though? Wouldn't it make more sense for us to like, go somewhere else or something?
: I'm just...interested in seeing the same thing you see every morning?
: Yikes. Your game needs some serious work, Sensei. You're much better at cafe banter than dorm room banter.
: I will do my best to improve for both of our sakes.
: I'll take your word for it.
: I'll also let you into my room if you promise not to only stop going to other cafes, but to stop saying weird and creepy shit.
: I don't know if you understand how hard that last part will be for me to accomplish.
: Then I suppose we will have to find out together!
: Now, onward to Casa del Rin!
Rin guides me into the room and unstraps her boots after realizing that the two of us won't be going anywhere any time soon.
I direct my attention to what is easily apparent as her side of the room before she takes her place in front of me, unsure of how to proceed.
: So, I guess if you're going to mug me, now is the best possible time.
: I'll abstain until the tour is over at the very least.
: Good call. It'll be a more effective shakedown if you know where all the good stuff is first.
: Well...if there was any good stuff, I mean.
: Our room's way outdated compared to all of the other ones on this floor.
: We've been waiting for our upgrade for literally forever but Futaba kept offering to wait because her heart is too big for her body.
: What sort of upgrade are you waiting for exactly?
: Pretty much everything. The school is kind enough to provide standard beds and stuff, but I think our floor and our color scheme is supposed to be changed or something too.
: It's just annoying since I've got tons of stuff I want to hang up but can't since I'll just have to take it all down once the thing starts.
: So...yeah. This is it for now. Sorry it's not really anything to write home about.
: My side is on the right and Futaba’s is on the left.
: She’s obviously not here right now, so it looks like it's gonna be just you and me for the indefinite future.
: And you don’t feel weird being alone in your room with an older man?
: Well, I didn't until you said that.
: I told you not sounding creepy wasn't going to work out.
: It's fine. We're still cool. I know you're not the type to try anything weird or whatever.
: Besides, let's just say I have countermeasures in place in the event that you do try anything.
: What...sort of countermeasures are you referring to, exactly?
: Nothing. Just don't look behind me.
: Why? What's-
I finally direct my attention to Rin's wall only to find a shelf comprised entirely of what appear to be...authentic human skulls.
: There's no way those are real, right?
: What kind of weirdo would keep fake human skulls on a shelf? Come on, Sensei.
: What kind of psychopath would keep real ones?
: The kind who was nice enough to let you into her room! Is your way of showing thanks going to be insulting all of my things?
: Are those even legal to own?
: Hey, I won't tell anyone if you don't. Leave my friends out of this.
: Okay. So I understand that there are real countermeasures in place now. Thank you for showing me.
: Any time, Sensei. Always willing to share my hobbies with a friend.
: So...do you have any hobbies aside from collecting body parts?
: Nothing exciting. Just playing guitar and listening to music and stuff.
: I guess that explains why you're always wearing headphones, then.
: Hey, I don’t always wear them. I’m headphone-less at work, aren’t I?
: I think you're technically supposed to be headphone-less at school as well, but it's not like I plan on enforcing that any time soon.
: Good, cause I'm running out of room on my shelf.
: I'm going to ignore that casual threat of murder and ask you about your guitar.
: What would you like to know, good sir?
: How long have you been playing?
: Not for super long, but long enough to be pretty decent at it.
: I've always loved music and stuff so my mom wound up buying me one for my birthday one year.
: Needless to say, I've been kinda hooked ever since.
: Would you be able to play something for me?
: Like...Like now?
: Sure. Why not?
: Uhh...probably because it's super embarrassing?
: You're not as good as you say you are, are you?
: That's really not the problem here, Sensei.
: What's the problem, then?
: The problem is that if I sit down and play guitar for you, it'll be an important moment that winds up heavily influencing the direction our relationship goes.
: Haven't you ever played a dating sim before? Or watched literally any sort of indie romance film?
: I have not done either of those things, no.
: Jesus. Next, you're going to tell me you don't listen to music either.
: Holy fuck!
: Is there some sort of crime against...not listening to music?
: Not a real one, but a social crime- yeah!
: Only creepy, borderline-sociopathic serial killers don't listen to music! That's like, an inarguable fact!
: Why would you even want to hear me play guitar if you don't like music? Wouldn't it bore you? Would you just walk away halfway through?
: I have so many questions!
: Well, I apologize for not being a standard human, but you can take solace in the fact that I am probably not going to kill you.
: You know I'm gonna have to show you some stuff now, right? I can't just let you live a life without music in it. That's no life at all.
: Do whatever you want. It's not like I hate music or anything. It just...never stuck with me, I guess.
: Wack. You're a weird dude, Sensei.
: You have a shelf full of human skulls.
: No. I have a shelf full of friends. It's very different.
: Okay. Well, on that note, I should probably get going. Ami normally complains if I’m late.
: Oh, right! I totally forgot you two were even related.
: Tell her I said hi, okay?
: Sure. I-
: Wait. Actually, don’t tell her I said hi. Because I know Ami and she’d probably be like 'Where did you see Rin?' And then you’d be all like 'In her room.'
: And then she'd be all like 'In her ROOM?' and then you would be all like 'Yeah. She's got skulls.'
: And then it would just be weird for everybody and no one would win.
: So, yeah. Don't say hi.
: Okay.
: Neat. Well, I guess that about wraps things up then.
: Thanks for dropping by, Sensei. Make sure to bring an offering the next time you show up.
: I'll come by again, but...I don't know if I can guarantee the offering part.
: Yeah, we'll see about that.
: Right...Goodnight, Rin.
: Night, Sensei! See ya round!
I exit Rin's room and...
Honestly, I think I know even less about her now than I did before I entered.
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
You can now spend time with her in her room!
